paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : F1 score results
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the F1 score results for three model configurations evaluated across five distinct datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categories, displaying the datasets in the following order: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The vertical value axis is labeled "F1 Score (%)" and uses a linear scale with a displayed range from 80 to 100, featuring numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 10. The chart utilizes a grouped bar layout, with three bars arranged side-by-side for each dataset category. According to the legend positioned at the top, the light green bars represent the "MADLLM" model, the light purple bars denote "MADLLM w/o feature embedding", and the light orange bars correspond to "MADLLM w/o skip embedding". All bars feature a thin black outline and do not display any additional visual emphasis. Visually, the light green "MADLLM" bar is consistently the tallest within every dataset group. The highest value represented in the chart is the "MADLLM" bar in the PSM category at approximately 97.5%, while the shortest bar overall is the "MADLLM w/o feature embedding" in the SWaT category, which sits at approximately 85.8%. The dataset categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically or by an overarching ascending or descending value.
